title: Bluetooth widget in a panel doesn't react to middle mouse button
line: Middle-clicking a standalone widget in a panel, like Bluetooth, now does its middle-click action, such as turning Bluetooth on or off.
explanation: Widgets outside the system tray use the shell's default compact representation, whose mouse area calls secondaryActivated on a middle click. The mouse area never set acceptedButtons, so it only received the left button and middle clicks fell through to the panel; the tray has its own item that accepts the middle button, which is why the tray icon worked. The change makes the mouse area accept the middle button too.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: let the default compact representation get middle clicks

The mouse area of the default compact representation handles the middle
button by calling secondaryActivated, but it only accepted the left one,
so middle clicks never reached it. Accept the middle button as well.

BUG: 511538

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/applet/DefaultCompactRepresentation.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/applet/DefaultCompactRepresentation.qml

@@ -69,6 +69,7 @@ Kirigami.Icon {
 
         anchors.fill: parent
         hoverEnabled: true
+        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.MiddleButton
         onPressed: wasExpanded = defaultCompactRepresentation.plasmoidItem.expanded
         onClicked: mouse => {
             if (mouse.button === Qt.MiddleButton) {

media.caption: Pure master: after middle-clicking the standalone Bluetooth widget (far right) Bluetooth is still on, as the tooltip said it would turn off
With the fix: the same middle click turns Bluetooth off (widget dimmed, tray Bluetooth icon gone); a second one turns it back on

review.text: Adding acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.MiddleButton to the MouseArea in DefaultCompactRepresentation.qml fixes a clear oversight where onClicked already handled Qt.MiddleButton via Plasmoid.secondaryActivated() but never received middle-click events. This matches the System Tray's PlasmoidItem behavior and also prevents middle clicks on desktop widgets from falling through to desktop paste. Left-click expand/collapse remains unaffected and the before/after verification clearly shows Bluetooth toggling.

reviews.text: Adding acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.MiddleButton to the MouseArea in DefaultCompactRepresentation.qml fixes a clear oversight where onClicked already handled Qt.MiddleButton via Plasmoid.secondaryActivated() but never received middle-click events. This matches the System Tray's PlasmoidItem behavior and also prevents middle clicks on desktop widgets from falling through to desktop paste. Left-click expand/collapse remains unaffected and the before/after verification clearly shows Bluetooth toggling.

Correct root cause: DefaultCompactRepresentation's MouseArea already branches on Qt.MiddleButton to call Plasmoid.secondaryActivated() but never accepted that button, while the tray forwards middle clicks into the same handler, so this one-liner makes standalone widgets behave like their tray counterparts. Right repo and layer, no lifetime or binding hazards; the middle press only records wasExpanded, which the left-click path re-records anyway. Before/after screenshots and the fake-BlueZ Powered toggles prove the fix, and the commit message matches the diff. The side effect (middle click on compact icons on the desktop no longer falls through to the containment's paste action) is consistent with tray behaviour and acceptable.
